about.title: About desavii
about.lead: desavii connects travelers with trusted local partners — hotels, tour operators, apartment owners, and experience hosts — across every destination we serve.

trust.title: Trust
trust.description: Every partner on desavii is verified before their listings go live, so you always know who you're booking with.

variety.title: Variety
variety.description: From city-center hotels to countryside tours, our marketplace covers every kind of trip, in every destination we serve.

support.title: Support
support.description: Our support team is here to help before, during, and after your trip — reach us through the Help Center.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.body: Desavii exists to make discovering and booking real places to stay, tours, and experiences across Armenia simple and trustworthy — for travelers planning a trip, and for the local businesses who welcome them.

about.partnerValueHeading: Why local businesses partner with us

reach.title: Reach more travelers
reach.description: List your hotel, tours, apartments, or experiences where travelers are already searching and comparing.

onboarding.title: Straightforward onboarding
onboarding.description: Apply, get verified, and publish your listings with tools built for how your business actually works.

fair.title: A fair marketplace
fair.description: You stay in control of your availability, pricing, and content — desavii is the discovery layer, not a middleman for your business.

discover.title: Discover
discover.description: Search and filter real, published listings across Armenia — hotels, tours, apartments, car rentals, and more.

book.title: Book
book.description: Request a booking directly with the local partner, with clear pricing and no hidden surprises.

enjoy.title: Enjoy
enjoy.description: Travel with confidence, knowing every partner on desavii is reviewed before their listings go live.

cta.heading: Ready to explore Armenia?
cta.body: Browse real listings from local partners, or list your own business on desavii.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Answers to common questions about booking, payment, cancellation, and becoming a desavii partner.

booking.question: How do I book a listing?
booking.answer: Open any listing's detail page and use the booking panel to check availability and pricing for your dates.

payment.question: What payment methods are supported?
payment.answer: Online payment is not yet available — this is a known limitation we're working on. Contact the partner directly for now.

cancellation.question: What is the cancellation policy?
cancellation.answer: Cancellation terms are set by each partner and shown on the listing's policies section before you book.

becomePartner.question: How do I list my property or business?
becomePartner.answer: Create an account, then apply to become a partner from your dashboard. See our Become a Partner page for details.

contactSupport.question: How do I contact support?
contactSupport.answer: Visit our Contact page for our support email and hours.
